name: Clorotepine
summary: Clorotepine, also known as octoclothepin or octoclothepine, is an antipsychotic of the tricyclic group which was derived from perathiepin in 1965 and marketed in the Czech Republic by Spofa in or around 1971 for the treatment of schizophrenic psychosis.

pharmacology.text: Clorotepine is known to have high affinity for the dopamine D1, D2, D3, and D4 receptors, the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C, 5-HT6, and 5-HT7 receptors, the α1A-, α1B-, and α1D-adrenergic receptors, and the histamine H1 receptors, where it has been it has been confirmed to act as an antagonist (or inverse agonist) at most sites (and likely is as such at all of them based on structure–activity relationships), and it also blocks the reuptake of norepinephrine via inhibition of the norepinephrine transporter.

uses.text: Clorotepine (INN; brand names Clotepin, Clopiben), also known as octoclothepin or octoclothepine, is an antipsychotic of the tricyclic group which was derived from perathiepin in 1965 and marketed in the Czech Republic by Spofa in or around 1971 for the treatment of schizophrenic psychosis.

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Antipsychotics in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。一般來說，抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、體重增加，以及僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安等動作問題，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。一般来说，抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、头晕、体重增加，以及僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安等动作问题，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: It came out of Czechoslovak drug research in the 1960s. Its middle ring has seven members including a sulfur atom, making it a dibenzothiepine.
fact.zh: 它出自 1960 年代捷克斯洛伐克的藥物研究。它中間的環是含一個硫原子的七元環，屬於二苯并噻庚因類。
fact.zhHans: 它出自 1960 年代捷克斯洛伐克的药物研究。它中间的环是含一个硫原子的七元环，属于二苯并噻庚因类。
